title: Interactive Haunted Trees
acceptance: Three distinct archetypes (A closest to ASSET-REF-001), bark-integrated faces, avatar-checked heights, ~50% faced, trunk/roots/branches never move, readable without neon; gameplay-distance screenshots.
Eye palette black/orange-yellow/purple at equal odds, chosen once per instance on the server, identical on both clients.
Gaze triggers within configured range and angle; not on a clear miss, behind the face, or when occluded.
On gaze the face returns to rest and freezes; resumes gradually only after 1 continuous second without observers; reacquisition cancels; interrupted animations settle validly.
Unobserved eyes track the nearest visible player in range, else idle glances and blinks; eyes, lids and mouth independently controllable; mouth override hook exists.
Two-client Studio test: global freeze, stays frozen while any observer remains, 1 s recovery on both, reset during delay, no stale state on leave/reset, no leaks on rapid toggling.
Gaze remote validated (tree, habitat, alive, distance, facing, line of sight), rate-limited, expires without keepalive, cosmetic only; trust boundary documented.
scripts/check.sh passes; no regression in existing Studio scenarios; part and instance counts recorded.
